PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
1A
CONTROL OF PESTICIDES ACT, No. 33 OF 1980
Order under Section 9
BY VIRTUE of the powers vested in me by paragraphs (a) and (b) of Section 9 of the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980,I, JAYAKODY ARACHCHIGE SUMITH, Registrar of Pesticides, do by this Order–
(i) declare that every pesticide specified in the Schedule hereto shall be an approved pesticide; and
(ii) classify such pesticides as specified in the Schedule hereto as general pesticides.
Dr. J.A. SUMITH,Registrar of Pesticides.
Peradeniya,01st November, 2016.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
